purpose: Teach: 初対面/待たさ/ヘッドホン/トレイ/興味津々/へっ/はぎ/通り過ぎる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと初対面の時の事を覚えているわ
lines.en: Gran, I still remember the day we first met, back when we were young.
lines.style: Soft opening exhale into memory. Slow reverent pace, warmth blooming mid-line, gentle trailing tenderness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お見合いで長く待たされた事もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you were once kept waiting ever so long at a matchmaking meeting, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Light teasing lilt over old affection. Unhurried pace, playful stress on the long wait, melodic tag.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがラジオのヘッドホンで深夜放送を聴かれた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I'd sit up listening to the late-night broadcasts through my radio headphones.
lines.style: Fond half-smile in the voice. Deliberate pace, hushed on the late-night listening, cozy settling finish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お盆、つまりトレイで朝食を運ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to carry in breakfast on a tray when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Tender domestic memory, gently amused. Slow pace, a small warm lift on the tray, soft question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新しい機械に興味津々だった
lines.en: Gran, back then I was brimming with curiosity over every new machine.
lines.style: Brightening with remembered excitement. Slightly quicker pace, boyish energy flickering, settling back into warmth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、「へっ、まだ若いさ」って粋に仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You used to say it so dashingly — 'Heh, I'm still young' — didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate imitation coloring the quote. Playful attack on the heh, melting into fond laughter after.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが秋の七草の萩、つまりはぎを愛された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I dearly loved the hagi — the bush clover of autumn's seven grasses.
lines.style: Quiet poetic reverence. Slowest pace, breath softening around the flower's name, wistful fading close.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、家の前を通り過ぎる馬車を眺められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you would watch the horse carts passing by in front of the house, wouldn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle faraway tenderness closing the talk. Slow pace, the image lingering, love steadying the final word.
